dialogues.speaker: Nargess
dialogues.text: That's right. Everyone knows that to ensure good funding, you have to get your application approved by the Akademiya first. With an approved project and Mora, you'll be able to hire more students.

dialogues.speaker: Nargess
dialogues.text: With students working for you and stable funding from the Akademiya, your bright future will very much be secured.

dialogues.speaker: Nargess
dialogues.text: Still, I don't think it's really worth it. Just think about the terrible competition you'll face. All in all, it's too much trouble to get your application approved.

dialogues.speaker: Nargess
dialogues.text: I mean, have you heard about how Azar put all his eggs in that one basket of his, and not only did it turn out empty, but he also lost his position in the process?

dialogues.speaker: Nargess
dialogues.text: It's all a big joke, I tell you.
